title: Playable Ads
content_data:
Playable Ad is an interactive ad format that provides a short, engaging experience attracting users and getting them to download your app or game. With playable ads, users experience an app or game before they decide to download. This ad format is an effective way to optimize cost per impression (CPM) by gamifying your ad and getting the most out of each impression.

To learn about the benefits of and design best practices for Playable Ads, see [Playble Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/playable-ads).

To learn about how to upload playables for ad creation, see [Upload playables](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-playables/v1.3).

This group consists of the following endpoints:
* [Upload a playable asset](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-a-playable-creative/v1.3)
* [Check the status of a playable asset](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/check-the-status-of-a-playable-creative/v1.3)
* [Save a playable asset](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/save-a-playable-creative/v1.3)
* [Get playable assets](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-playable-creatives/v1.3)
* [Delete a playable asset](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/delete-a-playable-creative/v1.3)
